decisions.title: Monorepo Package Layout and Boundary Architecture
decisions.summary: Strict pnpm workspace package boundary isolation separating graph, agent, ingest, eval, and web packages.

decisions.title: 512-d Matryoshka Dimension Truncation and L2 Normalization
decisions.summary: Mandates 512-dimension Matryoshka representation learning vector slicing and strict L2 re-normalization.

decisions.title: Fail-Closed Citation Verification and Zero-Citation Refusal
decisions.summary: Requires strict fail-closed citation verification: any response with 0 verified citations fails closed with refusal.

decisions.title: Strict openCypher Parameterization Against Injection
decisions.summary: Enforces parameterized queries with UNWIND batches for all openCypher executions, prohibiting string interpolation.

decisions.title: FalkorDB Connection Pool Resilience and Exponential Backoff
decisions.summary: Mandates reconnect backoff with jitter and query timeouts for all FalkorDB client connections.

decisions.title: Dual-Payload Cytoscape Graph Transformation and Node ID Convention
decisions.summary: Enforces canonical node ID formatting and dual-payload cytoscape transformation for frontend canvas rendering.

messages.author: Zeph (Core Lead)
messages.text: Demo feedback: the canvas showed a node the query never returned, because we padded the overview with defaults.

messages.author: Sam (Agent Engineer)
messages.text: That breaks the whole pitch. If the graph is unreachable we must say so, not draw something plausible.

messages.author: Zeph (Core Lead)
messages.text: We decided: the web canvas only ever draws nodes the graph returned, and on a failure it shows 'No graph, no answer'.

decision.title: The web canvas never draws a node the graph did not return
decision.summary: The web canvas draws only nodes returned by the graph; when the graph is unavailable it shows 'No graph, no answer' instead of placeholder or default nodes.

messages.author: Alex (Graph Engineer)
messages.text: Reloading the overview on every tab switch hammers FalkorDB. Can we keep the last graph around?

messages.author: Sam (Agent Engineer)
messages.text: Only if the UI says it is stale and never invents nodes. Cache what the graph returned, nothing else.

messages.author: Zeph (Core Lead)
messages.text: Agreed: the canvas may keep showing the last graph the database returned, marked as stale, while a refresh runs. It replaces the no-cache rule.

decision.title: The canvas may keep the last returned graph, marked stale, during a refresh
decision.summary: While a refresh runs the web canvas may keep showing the last graph FalkorDB returned, clearly marked stale; it still never draws nodes the graph did not return.
